skills.name: Chain Whip
skills.description: Brings out the power of a chain and swings it down at enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Enemy Skill Resistance -40% (8 sec) *Makes enemy skills unusable (8 sec) *ATK x 4000% Area Damage

skills.name: Power Release
skills.description: Raises a weaponized triangle ruler. Good effects on allies.  *Move Speed +190% (7 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +40% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: GACHIAKUTA
abilities.description: GACHIAKUTA Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Silence: Strength
abilities.description: Has a high chance of making all Strength type enemies' Skills unusable and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
